versions.subject: feat: proxynotshell owa variant rules
versions.detection:
selection:
    # Look for the header: X-OWA-ExplicitLogonUser: owa/mastermailbox@outlook.com
    cs-method: 'POST'
    c-uri|contains|all:
        - '/owa/mastermailbox'
        - '/powershell'
condition: selection

versions.subject: fix: add good ua as filter
versions.detection:
selection:
    cs-method: 'POST'
    sc-status: 200
    c-uri|contains|all:
        - '/owa/'
        - '@'
        - '/powershell'
filter:
    c-useragent:
        - 'ClientInfo'
        - 'Microsoft WinRM Client'
        - 'Exchange BackEnd Probes'
condition: selection and not filter
versions.spl: "cs-method"="POST" "sc-status"=200 "c-uri"="*/owa/*" "c-uri"="*@*" "c-uri"="*/powershell*" NOT ("c-useragent" IN ("ClientInfo", "Microsoft WinRM Client", "Exchange BackEnd Probes"))
